mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in monetary easing.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signal a 'Goldilocks' economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 3.5% AND UNRATE < 4.0%, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 20000.0) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1400.0) indicate late-cycle expansion, where sustained corporate earnings growth drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1400.0 AND GDPC1 > 20000.0, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals economic weakness and recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.0%, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.0%) combined with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) signals a 'transitory inflation' narrative, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.0% AND FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in recession risk.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.0%, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals supply chain disruption and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.
